title: Document safe recovery when a pre-schema-4 binary suggests resetting coordination data
outcome: Explain that an older binary's move/delete reset guidance must not be followed after a schema-4 rollback; use a schema-4-capable build to preserve coordination data.
acceptance: The central-control-plane feature brief distinguishes automatic refusal, which preserves data, from manually following the old binary's move/delete reset guidance, which discards or hides coordination state.
The rollback guidance tells operators to keep the upgraded coordination database intact and run a schema-4-capable build; it does not introduce a migration, reset or binary-backup requirement.
